title: review: P3/P6 wiring, shadow only: build evidence candidates from the execute and review packet builders, route them, log context_selection decisions and shadow reduction into packet_meta and the context scorecard; the model still receives the unchanged packet
spec:
Depends on T-0794 (orchestrator/evidence.py, orchestrator/context_router.py: make(), EvidencePool, route(), render(), decision_row() which returns the full keyword set for decision_log.record), T-0772 (promotion.mode("context_router"), decision_log kind context_selection) and T-0799 (execute prompt dedup; spawn.py changed there). This spec is self-contained; the program brief is not on the goal branch. Shadow means: compute and log; the bytes sent to any model are byte-identical to before this task (assert in tests).
Do:
1. spawn.py, execute path (_packet_body around lines 181-350): after `sections` are assembled and before the cap loop, build candidates via evidence.make(): one "architecture_note" for task spec (location task:<id>:spec) and one per acceptance line (task:<id>:acceptance:<n>); one "source_chunk" per write-scope file that exists (content = the file text bounded to 12000 chars, commit = merge_base sha) and one per read_scope path (content = the symbols lines for that path, provenance repo); one "memory_entry" per gotcha line and one "decision" per decisions line (provenance memory); one "previous_result" per evidence line from task inputs (provenance bus, trust untrusted); one "test_result" for each relevant_tests path (content = path only) and, for fix rounds, one for the failure block in the spec if a "Failures:" marker exists (content = that block). Add every candidate to evidence.EvidencePool(goal) (goal = task parent or task id). Call context_router.route(task, candidates, role="execute", head_sha=merge_base, cfg=Pool().cfg). When promotion.mode("context_router") == "off": skip everything in this step. When "shadow" or "active" (active is treated as shadow in this task and logs a warning once per process via notify: "context_router active not implemented; running shadow"): record decision_log.record(**context_router.decision_row(task, routed, mode=mode)) and extend the build meta returned by _packet_body with routed_tokens, routed_reduction_ratio, routed_hidden, routed_ambiguous, routed_rules_version, evidence_ids (list of ids, capped 200). packet_run_meta / with_instruction_tokens / bus.log_run (P1) must carry those keys through into the run's `context` object (bus.py: add the keys to the copied list). The router must never raise into the packet builder: wrap in try/except, log one notify line, and continue without the shadow keys.
2. spawn.py, review path (review_packet ~435-500): candidates = the scoped diff as one "source_chunk" per file hunk group (split raw_diff on "diff --git", location = the path, content = that file's hunks), spec/acceptance notes as above, previous review comments (fix-round context) as "review_finding". role = "security_review" when the packet carries the security section, else "review". Same logging and meta keys, same shadow guarantee.
3. context_scorecard.py: per role and per goal add columns shadow_routed_tokens (avg), shadow_reduction (avg routed_reduction_ratio), shadow_hidden (avg), shadow_ambiguous_rate (ambiguous / candidates); rows without the keys count as unmeasured for those columns only. `orchestrator scorecard --context` prints them.
4. Scout evidence reuse (P8 first step): scout_evidence.reuse_check may read evidence.EvidencePool(goal) ids by source_type "scout_finding" only if it is a one-line addition; otherwise leave scout_evidence untouched and note it.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_execute_packet_bytes_unchanged_under_context_router_shadow (build a packet with mode off and with mode shadow on the same fixture task; the packet text is identical; the shadow meta keys exist only in shadow), ::test_execute_packet_logs_context_selection_decision (one decision_log row of kind context_selection with subject = task id, no content field in the row), ::test_review_packet_routes_diff_files_per_path (a two-file diff gives two source_chunk candidates with those locations), ::test_router_failure_never_breaks_packet (monkeypatch context_router.route to raise; packet still builds; a notify line mentions the task); tests/test_context_scorecard.py::test_shadow_columns_present_and_unmeasured_rows_counted; tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_carries_routed_keys.
Docs: extend docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md with a "Shadow wiring" section (what is logged where, how to read the scorecard columns, revert path: set [context_router] mode = "off" or git revert). Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.
acceptance: docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md has a Shadow wiring section; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

result.summary: All required tests (tests/test_spawn.py::ContextTelemetry, tests/test_context_scorecard.py, tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_carries_routed_keys) pass, full suite (1067 tests) is green, and the docs Shadow wiring section is present. Packet bytes are verified byte-identical between off/shadow modes, decision_log/context_selection wiring and scorecard shadow columns are correct per their own tests. Two non-blocking issues found: an evidence-location naming mismatch with the (out-of-scope) context_router.py FULL-routing rule for acceptance notes, and candidate construction running before the mode=='off' check contrary to the spec's 'skip everything' instruction. Neither breaks acceptance criteria or the gate.

comments.issue: context_router._choice()'s FULL-routing rule for acceptance notes matches ev.location == f'task:{task_id}:acceptance' exactly (no index), but spawn.py (this diff) builds acceptance evidence with locations 'task:<id>:acceptance:<n>' per the spec's required naming. That exact-match branch can now never fire for any acceptance candidate, so acceptance criteria evidence always falls through to a lower routing tier (e.g. 'ambiguous'/LONG) instead of FULL/'acceptance'. context_router.py is outside this task's scope so this isn't a diff-introduced bug, but this diff is what first activates the mismatch in production (default context_router mode is 'shadow', not 'off') and degrades the shadow signal's usefulness for acceptance evidence. Doesn't break any of this task's acceptance tests.

Evidence candidates for both _packet_body (execute) and review_packet are built unconditionally via evidence.make()/file reads before promotion.mode() is checked inside _shadow_route; the spec says 'When promotion.mode("context_router") == "off": skip everything in this step.' Since default mode is 'shadow' this mostly doesn't matter today, but with mode explicitly set to 'off' the packet builder still pays for reading every scope file (up to 12000 chars each) and constructing/hashing all candidates before discarding them, and any exception during that construction (e.g. a race where a scope file is deleted between the is_file() check and read_text()) would raise outside the try/except in _shadow_route, breaking packet building even with the router fully disabled.
